About Me:

{/* Top two-column text layout */}

I'm Chris, a full-stack web developer based in New York City who enjoys turning messy, real-world problems into clean, thoughtful web experiences.

Most of my work centers around{" "} React,{" "} Next.js, and{" "} TypeScript — building data-driven tools like fantasy sports optimizers, smarter fitness tracking, and utilities for the Pokémon TCG. I care a lot about clear UX, performance, and writing code that's easy for the next developer to understand.

Right now I'm focused on sharpening my back-end skills with{" "} Node,{" "} APIs, and{" "} MongoDB, and growing into a role where I can ship production features, learn from more senior engineers, and contribute to a strong engineering culture.

Outside of coding, you'll usually find me competing in the Pokémon TCG, teaching chess to elementary school students, or lifting at the gym. I like anything that mixes strategy, iteration, and long-term improvement.

{/* Bottom cards */}

Problems I'm Solving

  • Shipping small, end-to-end features in real projects
  • Deepening my TypeScript and testing habits
  • Designing clean, predictable API contracts
  • Leveling up in performance, accessibility, and DX (developer experience)

Tech I Work With

React Next.js TypeScript JavaScript Node.js MongoDB CSS / SCSS REST APIs
